name: Confetti Burst Freeze
description: The product hangs frozen mid-air at the centre of an exploding burst of colorful paper confetti, every piece caught sharp and distinct by a bright high-key flash. Joyful, celebratory, campaign-ready energy against a pure white background.
subject: product
prompt: a small bottle, caught mid-air at the centre of a frozen burst of colorful paper confetti exploding outward in every direction, held dead-center in a symmetrical center-weighted composition with confetti radiating outward evenly on all sides, confetti in four to six saturated colors plus metallic gold and silver foil pieces, each piece individually distinct and physically plausible in shape — squares, circles, foil flecks — never covering more than about 15 percent of the bottle's silhouette, deep focus holding every confetti piece tack-sharp, bright high-key flash freezing the whole explosion with genuine studio-strobe color rendering, pure white background, joyful commercial-campaign energy, no other products or props in frame, clean professional product-photography finish
